issues.title: Circular/Structural-only ACs for Tracker Content
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-08 in the child trackers verify the existence of the spec files themselves rather than the logic or schema of the issue records they contain.
issues.fix: Add logic-based ACs that verify the 'Reproduction/Cause/Fix/Prevention' structure and the JSON schema validation of issue records.

issues.title: Truncated Evidence in Consolidated Findings
issues.why: The file 02-consolidated-audit-findings/00-overview.md is truncated at the end of the provided context, leaving F-24 incomplete and potentially missing subsequent findings.
issues.fix: Split the consolidated findings into smaller, logically grouped files (e.g., by severity or category) to stay under context limits.

issues.title: Unaddressed Schema Validation for Issue Records
issues.why: While a JSON schema is provided in 01-phase-2-git-logs-audit/00-overview.md, there are no examples of malformed records or negative test cases to confirm validation behavior.
issues.fix: Add a 'Negative Case' example to 01-phase-2-git-logs-audit showing a schema validation failure for a missing required field.
